title: Give share links a short form: frequencylocal.com/s/<code> that opens the public page with the sharer's ref and counts opens

source.ref: Daniel request 2026-11-02, short path on the apex, three PRs

detail:
Share buttons copy a long URL with ?ref=<profile id>. PR 1 (this row) adds the short code: share_links and share_link_opens tables (internal, per-day counts, no visitor data), the open_share_link RPC, lib/share (shortenablePath admits only public pages, ensureShareLink makes one stable code per page and sharer), and the /s/<slug> redirect that re-checks the public page and attaches the ref so the existing referral cookie and onboarding credit run unchanged. PR 2 switches the event, Space, profile, Spotlight, listing and invite share buttons and emails over. PR 3 shows link opens on each console. No new domain; a separate short domain was declined.

Short codes, freq.ie switch and per-link open counts shipped across PRs 1 to 3.
